Fine-center the bolt under the nut using the wrist image, lower a few millimeters, and begin a slow clockwise threading stroke.
Continue the yellow clockwise stroke while maintaining alignment, then open for a wrist reset without reversing the nut.
Reset the open left wrist counterclockwise while leaving the partially threaded yellow pair undisturbed.
Regrasp and make another controlled clockwise yellow tightening stroke with a small axial advance, then release.

Reset the open wrist and regrasp yellow without lifting or disturbing its coaxial engagement.
Continue controlled yellow tightening and release, keeping the left elbow configuration and the matching parts aligned.

Center the gray nut between the left fingers using the close wrist image, descend the last few millimeters, close fully, and test with a short lift.
Gray nut is visibly retained. Lift clear and carry it to the center staging area for a sequential right-arm pickup, without crossing arms.
Lower the gray nut onto the central staging area, open to release, and lift vertically before moving the left arm away.

Bring the right gripper downward-facing above the staged gray nut at center, maintaining elbow-up continuity and clearance from the parked left arm.
Lower the open right gripper toward the staged gray nut, stopping near grasp height for wrist-image centering.
Lower the final nine millimeters, close the right gripper on gray, and make a short vertical retention test before carrying it to its bolt.

Continue a controlled clockwise gray threading stroke with a small axial advance, then release for a wrist reset and visual seating check.

Reset and regrasp gray with the right hand. Adjust the left fingers laterally from the wrist image and lower to red nut grasp height.
Fine-center and grasp red with the left hand, then test retention by lifting. Continue the right-hand gray tightening stroke and release.
Correct the rejected tensor without compensating for unexecuted motion. Lift red toward center and reset the open right wrist, then regrasp gray.
Place red upright at center and release for transfer. Make another gray clockwise tightening pass with the right gripper, then open.

Withdraw the open right hand from gray, reset its wrist, and approach the staged red nut from the right while the left remains parked.
Lower the open right gripper toward the staged red nut, stopping above grasp height to refine alignment from the wrist view.
Refine right-hand alignment over the central red nut, lower to grasp height, close fully, and check retention with a small vertical lift.

Refine the red alignment by reversing part of the last lateral correction, lower to engagement, and begin a slow clockwise threading stroke.
Red now appears coaxially engaged. Continue a clockwise tightening stroke with a small axial advance, then open for a wrist reset.
